run_linear_evaluation: run a linear probe evaluation on a frozen DINOv3 model using CLI arguments and config
train_linear_classifiers: train multiple linear classifiers on top of frozen backbone features with grid search over learning rates
setup_linear_classifiers: build linear classifier modules for each learning rate and number of last blocks combination
create_linear_input: concatenate class tokens from intermediate blocks and optionally average-pooled patch tokens into a flat feature vector
eval_linear_with_model: evaluate a pretrained model by training linear heads on a dataset and testing on validation and test sets
